items.title: BRO Q3 deep dive: specialty headwinds and integration shape outlook for 2027
items.summary: Insurance brokerage firm Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 7.4% year on year to $1.73 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.07 per share was 1.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Why Brown & Brown (BRO) stock is trading lower today
items.summary: Shares of insurance brokerage firm Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) fell 4.9% in the afternoon session after the company reported slowing organic revenue growth and margin compression in its third-quarter 2026 financial results. According to the company’s press release and the earnings slides filed with it, Brown & Brown reported third-quarter revenue of $1.73 billion, up 7.4% from a year earlier.
